crossRefs.note: In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim of olive wood, each ten cubits high.

parallels.note: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.

people.name: Most_Holy_Place
people.line: The innermost room of the tabernacle and temple

translations.web: In the most holy place he made two cherubim by carving; and they overlaid them with gold.
translations.bsb: In the Most Holy Place he made two cherubim of sculptured work, and he overlaid them with gold.
translations.kjv: And in the most holy house he made two cherubims of image work, and overlaid them with gold.
translations.asv: And in the most holy house he made two cherubim of image work; and they overlaid them with gold.
